text:
eli: Heads up from onboarding today — two quick doc problems popped up: the SAML guide links to a retired IdP config at /handbook/security/saml#idp-azure which 404s, and the dedicated-sizing table in /handbook/dedicated/scale.md still lists GPU types we no longer offer (it mentions A100-80GB for small pools).

hana: ouch. which pool size page did customers hit? that A100 mention could be misleading for pricing.

eli: demo script pointed folks at /handbook/dedicated/scale.md under the "small pools" heading. also the SAML link is blocking an SSO onboarding step for an enterprise trial.

phil: I can patch the sizing table quickly. plan: replace A100-80GB with RTX6000-48GB (our new small-pool baseline), add a footnote about available custom hardware via Dedicated contracts, and update the table's "last-updated" frontmatter.

hana: I'll take the SAML link. suspect we just need to point to /handbook/security/saml-integrations#azure-ad instead of the old fragment and add a tiny troubleshooting note about Azure Enterprise apps. Also assign owner in frontmatter (security-team).

eli: pinging @docs-owners — can we get a quick owner assign so we can fast-track these fixes into the onboarding path? the customer is in the same-day trial.

docs-owners: assigning: phil (dedicated pages) and hana (security/SAML). please add frontmatter owner tags.

phil: opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1422 "dedicated: update sizing table, replace deprecated GPU, add note on custom hardware". I included a small CSV diff and a one-line changelog under "Docs: dedicated sizing table update". staging smokecheck included to verify table renders.

hana: PR up for the SAML fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1423 "security: fix SAML Azure anchor, add troubleshooting note, set owner". I also added a redirect mapping for the old fragment in the redirects.yml so external bookmarks continue to work.

infra-bot: Redirect ticket INFRA-721 created for anchor rewrite mapping (owner: infra-team).

eli: can we make the redirect a 302 for a week then 301? we want to be conservative for trial customers.

docs-owners: 302 for 7 days then flip to 301 sounds good. infra-team will coordinate.

phil: CI queued for docs PR #1422 — small smoke test checks table cells and a rendered "last-updated" date.

infra-bot: Docs CI build queued at 2025-03-10T11:02:00Z  docs-build #4278

phil: staging shows the new table and the note about custom hardware. LGTM from my side, tagging @finance to confirm pricing blurb is okay.

hana: staging anchor resolves to the Azure AD section and the troubleshooting note addresses the common role/claim mismatch. LGTM.

infra-bot: docs-build #4278 passed at 2025-03-10T11:04:12Z  smokecheck OK (table renders, anchor present)

eli: awesome — thanks both. two follow-ups: 1) can we add a tiny linter rule to flag GPU model names deprecated in the docs, and 2) add the SAML anchor redirect to the external redirects log so partners see it?

docs-owners: adding follow-up tasks to backlog: DOCS-189 (lint deprecated hardware names) and DOCS-190 (publish redirect to partners log).

phil: will file DOCS-189 and add a sample mapping for the linter.

hana: will coordinate DOCS-190 with partner-ops and infra. adding the frontmatter owner to both PRs now.

eli: confirmed onboarding unblocked. cheers :raised_hands:
